name: Grafana MCP
tagline: Query dashboards, metrics, and logs from Grafana via your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Grafana MCP server. List dashboards, query Prometheus/Loki/Tempo data sources, search for panels, and inspect alert rules. The canonical way to give an agent observability access to your self-hosted Grafana.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Grafana MCP server, maintained by Grafana Labs. Exposes the Grafana HTTP API as MCP tools: list dashboards, search by tag, query data sources (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, etc.), inspect alert rules, and fetch panel definitions.

## Why we recommend it

If you self-host Grafana (or use Grafana Cloud), this is the cleanest way to let your agent read dashboards and query your observability stack. Works with any data source Grafana supports — Prometheus metrics, Loki logs, Tempo traces, Elasticsearch, CloudWatch, etc. The auth is your standard Grafana API token.

## When to use it

- SRE agents that help debug production
- Pulling context from dashboards during incident response
- Custom queries against Prometheus metrics from chat
- Inspecting which alerts are firing and why
installInstructions:
1. Create a Grafana API key at https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/service-accounts/
2. Set: `GRAFANA_URL`, `GRAFANA_API_KEY`
3. `uvx mcp-grafana`

**For Grafana Cloud:** Use the same pattern with your cloud URL and API key.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Grafana is open source. Grafana Cloud has a free tier.
